name: vLLM prefill time-to-first-token histogram
notes: vLLM main, PrometheusStatLogger in vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default (EngineArgs.disable_log_stats defaults False); served at :8000/metrics. Bucket family name in --custom-histogram-buckets: time_to_first_token. Interval from request arrival to first output token. Same label set and same unit as every other vLLM metric, so a TTFT SLO can be defended on documented buckets.
